description: Pull the ads a company runs on Google (Search, YouTube, Shopping, Maps, Play) from the Google Ads Transparency Center by domain, brand name or advertiser ID: format, first and last shown dates, days active, preview, and with details the countries, EU impressions, platform split, variations and the ad text when Google renders it. Compares the Sherwood Apify Actor, the unaffiliated scrapesage Actor and a manual lookup on adstransparency.google.com, and picks one from volume and what the user needs. Use when the user says "google ads transparency scraper", "scrape the Google Ads Transparency Center", "what ads is <company> running on Google", "competitor Google ads", "how long has this ad been running", "does <company> advertise on Google", "export <brand>'s YouTube ads". Out of scope: Meta Ad Library, TikTok or LinkedIn ads, Google Display Network, ad spend figures.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
